# VediCosmic

> Free Vedic tools: today’s tithi and nakshatra, your birth star, planetary hours, numerology and a 17-minute daily sādhana. Calculated in your browser. No ads.

VediCosmic is a free Vedic astrology, panchang, numerology and practice website. Every tool runs its calculations in the visitor's browser.

## Tools

### [Numerology Calculators](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/category/numerology)

- [Numerology Calculator](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/numerology): Enter your name and date of birth to get your Life Path, Expression, Soul Urge and Personality numbers, with Mulank, Bhagyank, Kua and a Lo Shu grid.
- [Mobile Number Numerology](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/mobile-numerology): Check the numerology of a mobile number: its root, its compatibility level with your date of birth, and a reading for every two-digit combination. Free.
- [Lo Shu Grid Calculator](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/loshu-grid): Make your Lo Shu grid from your date of birth: see missing and repeated numbers, the planes, and your Mulank, Bhagyank and Kua number. Free, no sign-up.
- [Chaldean Numerology Calculator](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/chaldean): Type a name or a business name to get its Chaldean compound and root numbers, the ruling planet and a letter-by-letter working. Free, in your browser.
- [Life Path Number Calculator](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/life-path): Work out your Life Path number from your date of birth, with Mulank, Bhagyank, lucky numbers and colours, and your personal day, month and year.

### [Vedic Astrology Calculators](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/category/astrology)

- [Kundli (Vedic Birth Chart)](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/astrology): Make a free kundli from your date, time and place of birth: Lagna, Moon sign, nine grahas with nakshatra and pada, houses and Vimshottari dasha.
- [Hora Calculator](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/planetary-hours): See the hora running now and the planetary hours of the day and night for your city, counted from sunrise, with what each planet traditionally favours.
- [Navagraha Mandala](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/planet-mandala): Meet the nine grahas, from Surya to Ketu, on an interactive mandala: each one’s nature, colour and symbolism. Illustrative, not live positions.
- [Panchang & Choghadiya](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/panchang): Today’s panchang for your city: tithi, nakshatra, yoga and karana with end times, sunrise and moonrise, Rahu Kaal, Abhijit muhurat and Choghadiya.
- [Nakshatra Finder](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/nakshatra): Find your janma nakshatra and pada from your date, time and place of birth, then explore all 27 nakshatras with their deities, symbols and nature.

### [Practice Tools: Breath, Mantra and Meditation](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/category/energy)

- [Chakra Test](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/chakra-assessment): Answer 21 questions to see how your seven chakras compare on a radar chart, with a practice for each. A reflection exercise, not a diagnosis.
- [Japa Counter](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/mantra-timer): Count mantra japa on a 108-bead digital mala, one tap per bead, with eight mantras to choose from and a daily streak kept on your device. Free.
- [Trataka Meditation](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/tratak): Practise Trataka on a candle flame, bindu, Om or Sri Yantra in full screen, with a timer, breath pacing and guidance for the closed-eye afterimage.
- [Crystal Guide](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/crystals): Browse twelve crystals by the intentions traditionally linked to them, such as calm, clarity and protection, and keep a kit saved on your device.
- [Daily Contemplation Card](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/tarot): Draw one original contemplation card a day, reflect on its prompt and keep a private journal on your device. A reflection practice, not prediction.
- [Vastu Directions](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/vastu): Which direction suits the kitchen, bedroom, pooja room and entrance? A room-by-room Vastu Shastra guide with the element and reasoning for each.
- [Kundalini Meditation](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/kundalini): A gentle guided Kundalini meditation: a breath-paced video or an animated journey through the seven chakras with bija mantras. Stop if uncomfortable.
- [Pranayama Timer](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/pranayama): A guided breathing timer for Box breathing, 4-7-8, Nadi Shodhana, Bhastrika and slow belly breath, with voice cues in English or Hindi. Stop if dizzy.
- [Sound Bath Mixer](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/soundbath): Mix your own sound bath from six generated layers: tanpura, singing bowls, Om, rain, chimes and earth hum. Runs live in your browser, no recordings.
- [Chakra Frequency Player](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/chakra-frequency-player): Play seven chakra tones and Solfeggio frequencies with optional binaural or isochronic beats and a sleep timer. For relaxation, not treatment.
- [Urdhva Shakti](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/urdhva): A private companion for quitting porn: a one-tap urge SOS with guided breathing, a streak kept on your device, and daily reflections. No sign-up.
- [Daily Sādhana](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/sadhana): Start your daily sadhana: today’s tithi, nakshatra and moon phase, a three-step practice flow, and a streak kept on your device. Free, no sign-up.
- [Virtual Puja & Aarti](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/puja-aarti): Offer a virtual puja to one of seven deities: ring the bell, offer flowers, blow the conch or perform an aarti with the traditional invocation. Free.

### [Calendar and Cosmology Tools](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/category/cosmology)

- [Sacred Geometry Lab](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/yantra): Watch fourteen classical yantras, including the Sri Yantra, draw themselves stroke by stroke, and learn the ratios and angles behind each design.
- [Biorhythm Calculator](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/biorhythm): Enter your date of birth to chart your physical, emotional and intellectual biorhythm cycles for today and the weeks around it. A traditional model.
- [Ekadashi & Vrat Calendar](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/vrat-calendar): When is the next Ekadashi? See Ekadashi, Purnima, Amavasya, Pradosh and Sankashti Chaturthi dates for your city over the next 45 days. Free.

Methods and reference checks: https://vedicosmic.com/how-we-calculate

## Blog

- [Life Path Number Calculator: Full 2026 Guide to Meaning & Master Numbers](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/life-path-number-guide-2026): Learn to calculate your Life Path number by hand from your birth date, what numbers 1-9 mean, and why Master Numbers 11, 22 and 33 stay whole.
- [Lo Shu Grid Explained: Reading Your Birth-Date Magic Square](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/loshu-grid-explained): Learn to plot your birth date into the ancient Lo Shu Grid, decode its nine planetary numbers, and read the classic arrows of strength and weakness.
- [Numerology Compatibility: How Life Path Numbers Affect Relationships](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/numerology-compatibility-life-path): How numerologists compare two Life Path numbers to describe relationship dynamics — and why the reading stays one reflective lens, never a verdict.
- [Vedic vs Western Astrology: Why Your Moon Sign Might Be Different](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/vedic-vs-western-astrology): Why your Vedic Moon sign differs from your Western Sun sign — the real astronomical difference between the tropical and sidereal zodiacs, explained.
- [Nakshatras Explained: The 27 Lunar Mansions of Vedic Astrology](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/nakshatras-explained-27-lunar-mansions): What is your Nakshatra, or birth star? A clear guide to the 27 lunar mansions of Vedic astrology, their ruling deities, and what a Pada quarter is.
- [The 7 Chakras: A Beginner's Guide to Your Body's Energy Centers](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/seven-chakras-beginners-guide): A calm, practical guide to the 7 chakras — their traditional location, element and core meaning, from the grounding Root to the expansive Crown.
- [Panchang 101: Tithi, Nakshatra, Yoga & Karana Explained](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/panchang-101-tithi-nakshatra): A clear guide to the Hindu Panchang and its five limbs — Tithi, Vara, Nakshatra, Yoga, and Karana — and why they still guide Muhurta and Vrat dates.
- [How to Start a Daily Spiritual Practice (Sadhana) That Actually Sticks](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/start-daily-spiritual-practice-sadhana): Sadhana means a disciplined daily spiritual practice. Learn why consistency beats intensity, and five realistic ways to make yours actually stick.
- [Ekadashi Fasting Guide: Dates, Rules & the Spiritual Meaning of Vrat](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/ekadashi-fasting-guide): What Ekadashi is, why it falls twice a month, and how the traditional fasting vrat works — including who should check with a doctor first.
- [Pranayama for Beginners: 5 Breathing Techniques to Calm Your Mind](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/pranayama-for-beginners): A practical beginner's guide to pranayama, the yogic art of breath control: five techniques, from calming Bhramari to energizing Kapalabhati, with safe steps.
- [Mobile Number Numerology: Does Your Phone Number's Vibration Matter?](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/mobile-number-numerology): Learn how mobile number numerology reduces your phone number to a root number, what repeating digits mean, and how to read it against your Life Path.
- [Chaldean Numerology Explained: The Ancient System Before Pythagoras](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/chaldean-numerology-explained): Discover Chaldean numerology's ancient roots, its sound-based letter chart with no 9, and how to calculate a compound number from any name.
- [The Navagraha: Meet the Nine Planets of Vedic Astrology](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/navagraha-nine-planets-guide): Meet the Navagraha — the nine grahas of Vedic astrology, including shadow planets Rahu and Ketu — and how they shape Dashas and planetary hours.
- [Daily Card Contemplation: A Simple Reflection Ritual for Beginners](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/daily-card-contemplation-ritual): A daily contemplation card isn’t fortune-telling — it’s a simple reflective mirror. Learn a five-minute ritual for noticing what’s really on your mind.
- [What Is a Yantra? Sacred Geometry and the Math Behind the Sri Yantra](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/what-is-a-yantra-sacred-geometry): What a yantra actually is, how the Sri Yantra's nine triangles are built, and the geometry — and golden ratio claims — behind sacred diagrams.
- [What Are Biorhythms? Your Physical, Emotional & Intellectual Cycles](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/what-are-biorhythms-explained): A clear, honest look at biorhythm theory's physical, emotional and intellectual cycles — its origins, its appeal, and why science has not confirmed it works.
- [Vastu Shastra Basics: The Best Direction for Every Room in Your Home](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/vastu-shastra-basics): A practical introduction to Vastu Shastra — the eight-direction framework, the five elements, and which direction traditionally suits every room in your home.
- [Ūrdhvaretas & Brahmacharya: The Yogic View of Sexual Energy and Willpower](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/urdhvaretas-brahmacharya-yogic-view): A compassionate look at Brahmacharya and ūrdhvaretas — the yogic view of sexual energy — and how these ideas can gently support urge control.
- [Chakras 101: The Complete Guide to Your Body's Energy Centers](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/chakras-101-complete-guide): What are chakras, how many are there, and how do you actually work with them? A complete, no-hype overview of the chakra system in one place.
- [The 7 Chakras Chart: Colors, Symbols, Mantras & Meanings](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/seven-chakras-chart-colors-symbols-mantras): A quick-reference chart for the 7 chakras — colors, seed mantras, symbols and meanings for Root through Crown, side by side.
- [How to Calculate a Master Number in Numerology (Step-by-Step)](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/how-to-calculate-master-number): A focused, step-by-step guide to calculating and recognising Master Numbers 11, 22 and 33 in numerology — with the most common mistake to avoid.
- [All 7 Chakras Explained: Functions, Blockages & Healing Practices](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/all-7-chakras-functions-blockages-healing): Walk through all 7 chakras with their function, common signs of blockage, and a traditional healing practice for each — Root through Crown.
- [What Is a Chakra? Meaning, Origin & How the System Developed](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/what-is-a-chakra-meaning-origin): What does "chakra" actually mean, where does the concept come from, and how did the seven-chakra system as we know it develop over time?
- [The Chakras and the Subtle Body: How Prana Flows Through You](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/chakras-subtle-body-prana-flow): How do the chakras relate to prana, the nadis and kundalini energy? A look at the chakras as part of the wider subtle-body system.
- [A Simple Daily Practice to Balance All 7 Chakras](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/7-chakras-daily-balancing-practice): A short, beginner-friendly daily routine that moves through all 7 chakras — breath, posture and a moment of focus for each one.
- [Chakra Information: A Complete Reference Guide to All 7 Centers](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/chakra-information-reference-guide): A dense, at-a-glance reference for chakra information — Sanskrit name, location, element, seed sound and mudra for each of the 7 chakras.
- [What Are Chakras Used For? Benefits, Myths & Misconceptions](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/what-are-chakras-used-for-benefits-myths): What are chakras actually used for, what benefits do people report, and which common claims about chakras are myths rather than facts?
- [What Are the 7 Chakras? Simple Definitions for Each One](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/what-are-the-7-chakras-simple-definitions): What are the 7 chakras, in plain language? A short, direct definition for each one — Root through Crown — no jargon required.
- [Vedic Chakras: How the Chakra System Connects to Jyotish and the Navagraha](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/vedic-chakras-jyotish-navagraha-connection): How does the chakra system show up in Vedic astrology? A look at how Jyotish practitioners connect the 7 chakras to the Navagraha, the nine planets.
- [Navagraha Remedies: Mantras, Gemstones & Rituals for the 9 Planets](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/navagraha-remedies-mantras-gemstones-rituals): Traditional Navagraha remedies for each of the 9 planets — mantras, gemstones, colors and simple rituals used to pacify a difficult graha.
- [How to Calculate Your Biorhythm Cycles: A Step-by-Step Guide](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/how-to-calculate-biorhythm-cycles): A step-by-step guide to calculating your physical, emotional and intellectual biorhythm cycles by hand, from your date of birth.
- [Biorhythm Compatibility: Comparing Cycles Between Two People](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/biorhythm-compatibility-between-two-people): Can biorhythm cycles be compared between two people? A look at biorhythm compatibility theory, how it's calculated, and what science actually says.
- [Chakra Meditation for Beginners: A Guided Script for All 7 Centers](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/chakra-meditation-guided-script-seven-centers): A full, read-along chakra meditation script that guides you through all 7 energy centers, root to crown, in about 15 minutes.
- [How to Meditate on Your Chakras: Visualization Techniques for Each Center](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/chakra-visualization-meditation-techniques): Specific visualization techniques for meditating on each of the 7 chakras — color, light, breath and simple imagery you can actually picture.
- [Best Time to Meditate: Morning vs Evening Practice](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/best-time-to-meditate-morning-vs-evening): Is there really a best time to meditate? A clear, honest comparison of morning vs evening practice, plus what Vedic tradition adds to the question.
- [Chakra Sound Healing: Do Solfeggio Frequencies Really Work?](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/chakra-sound-healing-solfeggio-frequencies): Solfeggio frequencies are marketed as chakra-tuning sound healing tools. Here is what they actually are, their real history, and what science says.
- [Walking Meditation and the Root Chakra: Grounding Practices Beyond Sitting](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/walking-meditation-root-chakra-grounding): Sitting still isn't the only way to meditate. A guide to walking meditation as a Root chakra grounding practice — technique, benefits and safety.
